🟡 triage-bot operational notes — 2026-07-13 19:08Z cycle (4 groups, all known-issue-recurrence, 0 new/needs-human, 1 posted to #triage-results)

Two standing issues worth a look, both surfaced again this cycle:

1. `ki-2026-07-06-synthetics-signin-transient-step-duration-spike` (monitor 127198928, [Synthetics] Sign in to Method) just hit occurrence #22 — every single one has the same shape: 1 breach point >20s, self-recovers next run, zero corroborating error signal anywhere on the sign-in critical path. The KB entry's own playbook has said since occurrence ~3 that 2+ more no-evidence recurrences should trigger a recommendation to Admin to either raise the step-duration threshold or require 2 consecutive breaches before firing. That's been true for ~19 occurrences now and hasn't been escalated directly — flagging it to you now instead of letting it sit in the KB.

2. `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout` (monitor 77419271, gateway XHR errors) has now shown the same split for 6 consecutive occurrences over 2 days: ES confirms ~350+ Ocelot/ResponderMiddleware timeout hits each time, but `service:ms-gateway-api status:error` in DD Logs returns 0 every time. Either that facet isn't catching these warnings (a labeling gap) or the failure mode stopped producing server-side errors and the original diagnosis needs a re-look. The bot has no further mechanical way to resolve this — worth a manual check on the DD Logs pipeline config for ms-gateway-api.
